description: Header file providing utilities for handling ELF files, including traits classes for 32-bit and 64-bit ELF, and functions for validating ELF files, finding sections and segments, and converting offsets.

classes.name: ElfClass32
classes.description: Traits class for 32-bit ELF files, defining types and constants specific to ELF32.

classes.name: ElfClass64
classes.description: Traits class for 64-bit ELF files, defining types and constants specific to ELF64.

methods.name: IsValidElf
methods.description: Checks if the provided header points to a valid ELF file.

methods.name: ElfClass
methods.description: Determines the ELF class (32 or 64) of the given ELF binary.

methods.name: FindElfSection
methods.description: Finds a section by name and type within an ELF binary.

methods.name: FindElfSegment
methods.description: Finds a segment of a specified type within an ELF binary.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Converts an offset from an ELF header into a pointer in the mapped address space.
